#### 1. hearing loss, autosomal recessive 113  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.765)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:31948)

**Proposed mechanism:** CEACAM16 (HGNC:31948) —DISRUPTS→ Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0007155); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal hair morphology (HP:0000970); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000388). **How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in CEACAM16 that are exclusively associated with one of the two diseases and not the other, or variants with a gain-of-function effect, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Pathogenic variants in CEACAM16 with a frequency > 0.01% in gnomAD.)_

For instance, therapies aimed at restoring extracellular matrix integrity might benefit patients with both conditions.
